name: graph-uncertainty-scope
goal: Ignore only graph gaps proven unrelated to every active page during feature impact discovery

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: A Work component impact on 42c7 reports six dangling edges and 166 references. Five edges originate in tests and one is a scenario edge; every dangling edge currently makes all references block page discovery.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The existing scoped uncertainty matrix covers dangling unknown origins, but not a missing target reached only from an unrelated test or scenario versus the same gap reached from an active page. Extend that existing matrix without changing its case identity.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: At 48e8fd191d the existing coverage matrix rejected a dangling test-only edge despite complete unrelated page reachability. Matched red record cb342fe9eca311cdd47d5ca5b594a01d449ef77f14a8d5a367adad2208c6e958.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: At 469d28c255 only scenario edges and test/source gaps proven unreachable from active pages are excluded; missing page anchors, unknown origins, ambiguous nodes and page-reachable gaps remain blockers.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: The unchanged coverage case passed in the same clean-snapshot environment; green record 3600305b65af2c0582008c9e214a63734315486746514edac3f81389e0cf80cd. Isolated mutations removing reachability or ownership checks each failed the matching assertion, and the restored test passed.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
